title: Sample Transfer to 96 Well-Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the OT‑2 deck as follows: Slots 1, 4, 7, 10 – Custom 24‑tube tube racks; Slot 2 – 96‑well plate; Slot 3 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack; Slot 5 – Opentrons 1000 µL filter tip rack.

steps.title: Load labware definitions
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package containing the custom labware definitions for the reservoir and plate, then upload the labware definition file in the OT App.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the prepared protocol (JSON) into the OT App.

steps.title: Calibrate hardware
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the 96‑well plate, each 24‑tube rack, and both tip racks (200 µL and 1000 µL) as well as the pipette you will use.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the customizations field, specify: • Number of samples – total tubes to be transferred (samples must be placed in the tube racks by column, starting with the rack in Slot 1). • Volume dispensed (µL) – a value > 100 µL will select the P1000 pipette; ≤ 100 µL will select the P300 pipette. • Delay time after aspirating (seconds) – optional pause after each aspiration (0 s allowed). • Aspiration height (mm) – tip immersion depth.

steps.title: Run transfer protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the protocol: for each source tube, the robot will pick up a fresh tip (new tip for every transfer), aspirate the specified volume, wait the defined delay, and dispense into the corresponding well of the 96‑well plate. Transfers are performed column‑wise within each tube rack, starting with the rack in Slot 1, completing all columns before moving to the rack in Slot 4, then Slot 7, and finally Slot 10.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated liquid‑handling sequence.
